note: Malawi, read on the Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services' own pages (immigration.gov.mw) on 2026-10-30. A Temporary Employment Permit is issued before entry for specified employment, applied for by the employing organisation (read as work for the sponsor) while the applicant waits outside Malawi; it goes to the TEP Approval Committee and then the Minister, and can be renewed twice (its term isn't stated). A Business Residence Permit lets a self-employed person, partner or proprietor carry on a business, profession or occupation for gain with at least $50,000 invested from abroad; it is valid 5 years and renewable for successive 5-year periods (where it is applied for isn't said: either). A Permanent Residence Permit may be asked for by, among others, anyone ordinarily resident in Malawi for not less than five years (kept as each route's years to it, read as applied for in Malawi). Fees are paid within 30 days of approval but aren't on these pages; the years naturalisation asks aren't read.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services (Malawi), Temporary Employee Permit
sources.said: This permit is issued to persons before they enter Malawi for the purpose of taking up specified employment in Malawi. ... The organisation has the responsibility to apply for the permit on behalf of the applicant ... A TEP can be renewed twice through submission of a TEP Renewal Application Form ... All applicants for new TEP are required by law to wait outside Malawi until the application has been approved.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services (Malawi), Business Residence Permit
sources.said: This is a permit which authorizes a person to reside in Malawi for the purpose of carrying on, practicing or engaging in such business, profession or occupation for gain, profit or reward as self –employed person or a partner or proprietor. ... The permit is valid for 5 years from date of approval and is renewable for successive period of 5 years.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services (Malawi), Permanent Residence Permit
sources.said: It is a Permit issued to a person authorising one to reside in Malawi permanently. ... any person who has been ordinarily resident in Malawi for a period not less than five years.
